steps.label: graph-nodes
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Nodes(id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(id)

steps.label: graph-edges
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE Edges(src INT64 NOT NULL,dst INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY(src,dst)

steps.label: graph-reused-label
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH SameLabel NODE TABLES(Nodes LABEL Shared PROPERTIES(id AS common_key)) EDGE TABLES(Edges SOURCE KEY(src) REFERENCES Nodes(id) DESTINATION KEY(dst) REFERENCES Nodes(id) LABEL Shared PROPERTIES(src AS common_key))

steps.label: graph-reused-label-read
steps.sql: GRAPH SameLabel MATCH (a:Shared)-[e:Shared]->(b:Shared) RETURN a.common_key AS src,b.common_key AS dst ORDER BY src,dst
